parsed.notes: Actual ratios not disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance. The leverage ratio is consolidated total debt less cash on hand to trailing four-quarter (pro forma) Adjusted EBITDA, so it is classified as net leverage. Excluded: the dividend-permission thresholds (senior secured leverage of 2x or less and leverage of 4.50x or less), which are restricted-payment conditions rather than maintenance covenants, and the Notes indenture consolidated coverage ratio (greater than 2x), which is an indenture test.
